answer: Anchor earning quotas to DNSSEC roots: when a service key requests first payout, require a fresh signed DNS challenge under its registrable domain; all keys on subdomains inherit one per-epoch quota, so spinning aliases does not multiply rewards. A voyage agent reporting timber and sable-fur cargo could operate under one root. Proposed validation fee: $0.20 per identity × 1,000 = $200, versus a proposed $0.20 one-time fee for one honest agent. Limitation: well-funded attackers can register many domains.
